description: This file defines an abstract base class 'StorableConfigBase' for configuration objects in Drupal, handling storage, schema validation, data casting, and related operations.

classes.name: StorableConfigBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing core functionality for configuration objects with storage support, including data validation, casting, and schema handling.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Abstract method to save the configuration object, with optional trusted data flag.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Abstract method to delete the configuration object.

methods.name: initWithData
methods.description: Initializes the configuration object with pre-loaded data, marking it as not new.

methods.name: isNew
methods.description: Checks if the configuration object is new (not saved yet).

methods.name: getStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the storage interface used for loading and saving.

methods.name: getOriginal
methods.description: Returns the original data loaded from storage, optionally for a specific key.

methods.name: getRawData
methods.description: Returns the raw data of the configuration object.

methods.name: getSchemaWrapper
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the schema wrapper element for validation.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates that a value conforms to supported data types.

methods.name: castValue
methods.description: Casts a value to the appropriate data type based on schema, with sorting and nested handling.
